_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored). SSIDs are personal data — never commit the real file.
_estimate_comment: Never-measured nets are unreliable (public wifi shows strong signal but throttled/captive backhaul), so a radio estimate is discounted + capped and won't pull you off a working link on its own.
_metered_comment: Your phone hotspot. Judged on its REAL measured speed (not assumed slow), just probed rarely + cheaply to save cellular. The factor (<1) means a roughly-equal unlimited wifi is preferred, but a clearly-faster hotspot keeps you.
_passwords_comment: SSID -> wifi password. With a password the watcher joins that network directly (no outage, full throughput-based switching). Without one it can only disassociate + let macOS auto-join, which just escapes a lower-priority net. This file lives outside the git repo; never commit real passwords.
